description: Baseline random init; also prints the task object's public attributes to learn the interface.
Random init; prints task method signatures, dev-seed examples and forward shapes.
Window/match/pool circuit wired up but head ignores overlap and always answers 1 (class-prior baseline).
Fraction of s2 4-grams found exactly in s1 via attention, thresholded at 0.35.
4-gram overlap thresholded lower at 0.25; adds a Python-only dev report comparing candidate features by AUC.
s2 3-gram overlap with s1 thresholded at 0.33; dev report compares symmetric, prefix, stem and long-word features.
Bidirectional 3-gram overlap (s1 and s2 positions both matched against the other sentence, L2 non-causal), threshold 0.33.
Bidirectional stem overlap: pool only 4-grams starting at a word boundary (space plus first 3 letters), threshold 0.33.
Equal blend of bidirectional 3-gram overlap and word-stem overlap, threshold 0.30.
Gram + stem blend with pooling weighted toward early s2 positions (log-weight ramp 2.0), threshold 0.30.
Gram + stem blend with fuzzy matching: null slot lowered so shingles differing by one bit-flip pair still count, threshold 0.30.
Fuzzy gram + stem blend (margin 3) with the threshold raised to 0.42 to match the higher fuzzy overlap scale.
Fuzzier gram + stem blend tolerating two flipped bits per shingle (margin 5), threshold 0.40.
Fuzzy gram + stem blend (margin 3) with a length term: head adds 0.1 times s2 fill, threshold 0.46, so short s2 needs more overlap.
Simplification: fuzzy bidirectional 3-gram overlap alone (stem head dropped) plus the 0.1 s2 fill term, threshold 0.54.
Fuzzy 3-gram overlap with all vowels sharing one code, so inflected word forms match more easily; fill term 0.1, threshold 0.54.
Same fuzzy 3-gram + fill circuit as E15 rebuilt at d_model 48 with one match head and a 3-char window, about 7x fewer parameters.
E17 circuit shrunk further: 5-bit character codes (enough for the letters in prompts) and d_model 30.
Compact D30 circuit with soft match attention (sharpness 1 instead of 10): partial shingle agreement contributes a graded amount.
Compact D30 circuit with letter-level IDF: pooling up-weights positions holding rare English letters (hand-written frequency classes).
Compact D30 circuit restored to strict causal attention: only s2 positions are matched against s1, fuzzy 3-gram + fill, threshold 0.54.
Causal compact circuit with the s2 length term doubled to 0.2, threshold 0.64, keeping the effective cut for full-length sentences.
Causal compact circuit using exact character bigrams instead of fuzzy trigrams; fill term 0.2, threshold 0.76.
Cleaned-up causal circuit with unused registers removed: d_model 24, three attention layers, fuzzy 3-gram overlap + fill term, no MLP.
Minimal D24 causal circuit with the separator embedded like a space, so the first word of s2 can match a word inside s1.
Minimal D24 circuit with threshold 0.62; dev report adds overlap-decile label rates and a Python-only comparison of structural features.
Minimal D24 circuit with threshold 0.60, aiming the 0 answer at the low-overlap region where the dev label rate falls below one half.
Minimal D24 circuit with the length term removed: answer 1 iff fuzzy 3-gram overlap exceeds 0.42.
Smallest circuit so far: d_model 22, heads 2/1/1, no fill head; answer 1 iff fuzzy 3-gram overlap of s2 with s1 exceeds 0.42.
D22 circuit with exact 3-gram matching (no bit tolerance), threshold 0.34: the plainest possible reading of the rule.
D22 fuzzy 3-gram circuit with the threshold raised to 0.46 to check sensitivity of the single decision constant.
D22 circuit with hand-designed phonetic character codes: alike-sounding letters differ by one bit, so fuzzy matching forgives spelling and tense variation.
D22 fuzzy 3-gram circuit with match sharpness lowered to 3 to test whether a softer match bit changes the decision.
D22 circuit with fuzzy 2-grams tolerating one flipped bit, threshold 0.68.
Causal circuit widened to d_model 28 for fuzzy 4-grams with a four-character window, threshold 0.34.
D28 circuit with 4-grams tolerating two flipped bits, threshold 0.40: wider tolerance scaled to the longer shingle.
D28 4-gram circuit pooling with extra log-weight on late s2 positions (ramp 1.5), since dev tail coverage out-ranked head coverage.
Negative control: threshold 1.1 is unreachable, so the head always answers 0; checks the decision path and the class balance.
Causal D28 circuit counting word stems: a fourth window head flags 4-grams starting at a boundary and pooling only reads those, threshold 0.44.
Causal D28 stem circuit with exact matching: a word counts only if its first three letters and leading boundary occur together in s1, threshold 0.34.
Exact causal stem circuit with the threshold lowered to 0.26, moving the cut toward the region where the label rate actually drops below one half.
Causal D32 circuit blending all-shingle and word-stem 4-gram overlap equally from one match head, threshold 0.30.
All-shingle plus word-stem blend at d_model 32 with one flipped bit tolerated, threshold 0.36.
Fuzzy all-shingle plus stem blend at d_model 32 with the threshold lowered to 0.32.
Fuzzy blend at d_model 32 weighting stems at 0.25 and all shingles at 0.75, threshold 0.30.
Fuzzy blend at d_model 32 weighting stems at 0.75 and all shingles at 0.25, threshold 0.34.
Blend at d_model 32 with two flipped bits tolerated per 4-gram, stem share 0.25, threshold 0.38.
Blend at d_model 32 with soft match attention (sharpness 3), two flipped bits tolerated, stem share 0.25, threshold 0.38.
Minimal D22 fuzzy 3-gram circuit with threshold 0.40, bracketing the chosen 0.42 from below (E31 bracketed it from above at 0.46).
Final pick, same weights as E29: fully causal d_model 22 circuit answering 1 iff fuzzy 3-gram overlap of s2 with s1 exceeds 0.42; rerun to confirm reproducibility.
